mission_01: Logic Neural Networks (LogicNNs) bridge symbolic logic and neural computation by implementing logical operations (AND, OR, NOT) as differentiable neurons. Each logic neuron uses weighted sums and sigmoid activations to approximate boolean operations in continuous space, enabling gradient-based learning while preserving logical semantics. AND neurons use positive weights with a negative bias so that output is high only when all inputs are high. OR neurons use positive weights with a less negative bias so that any high input produces a high output. NOT neurons use negative weights to invert a single input. In this mission, you implement logic neurons for AND, OR, and NOT operations, compose them into layers, and build networks that evaluate logical formulas with continuous inputs.
